{{Top}}
'''Fuel pods''' were supplemental fuel tanks connected to the [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] of an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. This gave the pilot an extended mission time plus enough fuel to escape any [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity wells]] and a safe return to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

Around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] attached fuel pods to their ships before the [[Second Battle of Borleias]]. Equipped with a quick release system to jettison the empty pods, they provided the X-Wings with an additional forty five minutes of flight time. [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] pilot [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] used his malfunctioning fuel pod as an impromptu missile and destroyed a pursuing [[TIE starfighter]].
